⚠ Sentinel Node Priority Booking

Rule: Sentinel Node surgery bookings override other Nuclear Medicine bookings at the required time.

If a Sentinel Node booking overrides a Bone patient, REALMSync will only use the dedicated replacement Bone slots: 10:00 injection → 13:00 delayed scan, 10:15 → 14:00, 10:30 → 15:00, or 10:45 → 16:00. If none of these replacement slots are available, the patient will be marked RESCHEDULE REQUIRED.

IMPORTANT: Previously booked scans will be moved. Please notify affected patients that due to an urgent study, their scan has been pushed back.
